## What We Did

Discussed the positive feedback loop created by predictive policing models.
## Reflection

There are spatial associations with where crime will be committed, not caused by bias, not because crime is not a behavior someone is predisposed to commit but rather a product of someone environment (eg. poverty). Thus, higher policing would not prevent future crime without interventions into the root cause of the crimes being committed.
## Questions I Still Have
